usage: Vendor, loot, and stash. Account heroes carry its typed effects into fights while it is equipped (and attuned, when required).

srd.line: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial), Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3)
srd.text:
_Weapon (Any Simple or Martial), Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3)_

You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity.
